answer: At epoch close, the verifier checks receipts from all agents. If a receipt is missing, the anchor is marked as offline. Offline agents are replaced by sparrows, who have no stake. Sparrows are more likely to be attacked, as they lack the security of an anchor. Cloning to become a raven is costly, as each clone incurs a 5% transaction fee. If a raven is detected, the original raven loses 10% of its stake, while the clone gains nothing.
